description: SEBI circular SEBI/HO/IMD/DF3/CIR/P/2020/225: per-fund overseas limit raised to USD 600m within the industry limit of USD 7bn; overseas ETFs USD 200m per fund within an industry limit of USD 1bn. Limit raised (open). Circular text read.

SEBI circular SEBI/HO/IMD/IMD-II/DOF3/P/CIR/2021/571: per-fund overseas limit raised to USD 1bn within industry limit USD 7bn; overseas ETFs USD 300m per fund within industry limit USD 1bn; effective immediately. Limit raised (open). Circular text read.

Motilal Oswal MF notice-cum-addendum: lump-sum and switch-in suspended from 2022-01-17 (cut-off 2022-01-14) in MO S&P 500 Index Fund, MSCI EAFE Top 100 Select Index Fund and Nasdaq 100 FoF, citing the fund-house overseas limit (SEBI circular 2021/571). Close. Feeder funds; the ETFs themselves are not named.

SEBI emailed AMFI (28 Jan 2022) and AMFI clarified (30 Jan 2022): mutual funds to stop subscriptions into overseas schemes to avoid breaching the industry-wide overseas limit allowed by RBI. Close. The email and AMFI note themselves were not seen; the dates are quoted in the Motilal notice of 2022-02-01. Press (Business Standard) reported it on 2022-01-29.

Motilal Oswal MF notice-cum-addendum: transactions suspended from 2022-02-02 (cut-off 2022-02-01) in the S&P 500, MSCI EAFE and Nasdaq 100 FoF/index funds and Nasdaq 100 ETF and Q 50 ETF; direct creation of ETF units by the AMC stops, citing SEBI email of 28 Jan and AMFI clarification of 30 Jan 2022. Close.

Mirae Asset MF notice (reported): subscriptions suspended after the 2022-02-01 cut-off in its overseas ETFs and their fund-of-funds (NYSE FANG+, Hang Seng TECH, S&P 500 Top 50). Close. Notice not located; seen only in a search-engine summary.

Motilal Oswal MF notice-cum-addendum: existing SIP/STP paused from 2022-04-01 in S&P 500 Index Fund, MSCI EAFE Top 100 Select Index Fund and Nasdaq 100 FoF, citing the industry-wide overseas limit; to be reactivated once regulators raise the limit. Close.

SEBI letter SEBI/HO/OW/IMD-II/DOF3/P/25095/2022 (17 Jun 2022) and AMFI circular AMFI/35P/MEM-COR/15/2022-23 (20 Jun 2022): mutual fund schemes may resume subscriptions and overseas investments up to the headroom available as at 2022-02-01, at fund-house level. Open (partial). Letter and AMFI circular not seen; reference numbers and dates are quoted in Motilal notices of 2022-09-15 and 2023-03-03. Press: Moneylife, Daily Pioneer.
Nippon India MF suspended subscriptions into five overseas schemes including Nippon India ETF Hang Seng BeES, citing the limit (press report of 2022-06-30). Close. Primary Nippon notice not seen.

Motilal Oswal MF notice-cum-addendum: direct creation of units in Nasdaq 100 ETF and Q 50 ETF reopened from 2022-09-19, through authorised participants / market makers only, until further notice. Open.

Motilal Oswal MF addendum: from 2022-12-01 lump sum or switch-in accepted up to Rs 2 lakh per PAN per calendar month in S&P 500 Index Fund, MSCI EAFE Top 100 Select Index Fund and Nasdaq 100 FoF; SIP/STP restrictions continue. Open (partial).

Motilal Oswal MF addendum: new lump sum, STP and switch-in applications after the 2023-03-10 cut-off not accepted in S&P 500 Index Fund, MSCI EAFE Top 100 Select Index Fund and Nasdaq 100 FoF (AMC-level overseas limit); direct creation in Nasdaq 100 ETF and Q 50 ETF continues. Close (feeders only).

SEBI letter to AMFI (20 Mar 2024, reported 21 Mar): from 2024-04-01 funds to stop accepting fresh inflows into schemes investing in overseas ETFs (USD 1bn industry ETF limit about to be breached); limit use to be valued at cost. Close. Letter not seen; press only (Business Today, Value Research).

NSE circular NSE/NMF/64537: temporary suspension revoked in certain Nippon India MF schemes on the NSE Invest platform (press: overseas schemes resumed 2024-10-15). Open. Title seen in NSE listing only; scheme list (zip) not read.

NSE circular NSE/NMF/64597: temporary suspension of subscriptions in certain Nippon India MF schemes on the NSE Invest platform (press: overseas schemes stopped again from 2024-10-18 to comply with SEBI limits). Close. Title seen in NSE listing only; scheme list (zip) not read.

Motilal Oswal MF addendum dated 2024-12-05: new SIP registrations and SIP top-ups discontinued in S&P 500 Index Fund and Nasdaq 100 FoF from close of business 2024-12-10; existing lump-sum, STP and switch-in restrictions continue. Close.
NSE circular NSE/NMF/65572: temporary suspension of SIP in certain Motilal Oswal MF schemes on NSE Invest platform (follows the AMC notice of 2024-12-05). Close. Title seen in NSE listing only.
NSE circular NSE/NMF/65967: temporary suspension for subscriptions in certain Motilal Oswal MF schemes on NSE Invest platform. Close. Title seen in NSE listing only; schemes not read.
